claims.text: Reported gains for Informer do not survive covariate shift between train and test splits on ETTh1, ETTh2.
Informer is best characterised as sparse-attention transformer with ProbSparse self-attention.

evidence.description: Held-out year-splits reduce Informer advantage to within 1% MSE of the DLinear baseline.

limitations.text: Distribution shift between train and test periods is not explicitly modelled.
Evaluation is restricted to public benchmarks and may not reflect production settings.

future_work.text: Investigating whether patching interacts with frequency-domain decomposition.
Pretraining on a mixture of datasets to test transfer.
